initialization.scope: Repeated six-calibration-source startup constraints; ordinary data stream remains separate; development excluded

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: Remainders include nonlinear response and arithmetic, not pure curvature. A feasible smaller point establishes grid truncation, not useful convergence; finite-anchor generalization remains unproved.
